Subject: SI Certification Pilot — kickoff & curriculum outline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking the time to talk yesterday. BrightLayer is excited to kick off a small pilot to certify a core group of consulting partners to accelerate joint delivery with Redwood. Attached is an initial outline that covers: curriculum tracks, lab/practice exercises, certification criteria, and an suggested 8-week timeline.

Key asks from our side:
- Can your team review the curriculum and confirm which Redwood product owners we should invite to co-deliver (runtime, console, optimize)?
- We need confirmation of 8 sandbox seats and API keys for partner labs for the pilot window (Aug 6 — Sep 27).
- Any security or legal gating items (MSA addendum, data handling) we should route now so they don’t block the training schedule.

I attached BrightLayer_SI_Outline_v1.pdf — high level only. We can iterate quickly. Proposed kickoff: Wed Aug 2, 11am PT (60m).

Thanks,
Tom Wells
Head of Alliances, BrightLayer Consulting

Tom —

Appreciate the outline and the clear asks. This is aligned with what we discussed. High-level responses below and a couple of clarifying questions.

Quick answers:
- Product owners: I’ll loop in product leads from Serving Runtime (Jordan) and Console (Marissa) to co-review and join the kickoff. They’re CC’d.
- Sandbox seats & API keys: we can provision 10 partner seats in a dedicated sandbox project and scoped API keys for the pilot. Need partner account emails and intended test quotas so we can size appropriately.
- Legal/security: we’ll have our partnerships legal and security SME review the MSA addendum. If BrightLayer can send a one-page summary of requested data handling changes it speeds review.

Suggested additions to curriculum:
- Day 0: Solution orientation + architecture patterns (45m)
- Day 1–2: Hands-on lab (sandbox, sample datasets, guided prompt sets)
- Day 3: Performance tuning & quantization basics (runbook + benchmarks)
- Day 4: Observatory & SLOs — routing, fallbacks, cost controls
- Week 4: Certification exam (practical exercise + oral review)

I attached a short draft (SI_Onboard_Draft.docx) with our recommended lab plan and grading rubric — please review and flag any deal/kickoff constraints.

Proposed kickoff slots: Wed Aug 2 11am PT (your original) or Thu Aug 3 9am PT. I’ll hold both and we can confirm.

Action items for BrightLayer:
1) Return the partner roster for sandbox seats (emails + preferred usernames)
2) Short MSA addendum summary (1 page) for legal scope
3) Confirm pilot contact for day-to-day logistics (name + mobile)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com

Hi Soojin —

Great — thanks for the rapid reply and the draft. Quick updates from BrightLayer:
- We’ll provide the partner roster by EOD Mon (we have 9 consultants confirmed).
- Attached is a one-page summary of the MSA addendum requests (BL_MSA_Addendum_Summary.pdf). We propose a short addendum focused on sandbox data handling, retention windows, and audit logging for the pilot only.
- CedarOps (copied) will handle the lab provisioning on our side; they flagged EU data residency questions. Does Redwood have an EU sandbox region we can pin partner labs to? If not, CedarOps suggested workarounds.

On procurement/legal: our procurement lead prefers a DocuSign addendum rather than a full amendment to your MSA. I can initiate that once your legal team greenlights the summary. DocuSign link (tentative): https://www.docusign.com/BL-MSA-Addendum-2028

Kickoff slot: Aug 2 11am PT works for our core team. If you can send a calendar invite I’ll forward to the confirmed consultants once roster is complete.

Tom

Tom —

Thanks, all — calendar invite sent for Wed Aug 2, 11:00–12:00 PT (Zoom). Please confirm the roster before EOD Mon so we can provision API keys by Tue afternoon.

Quick notes from our security touchpoint:
- We can host partner sandboxes in our EU region for any EU-based consultants; reach out to integrations@redwoodinference.com with the list and we’ll pin their projects.
- For the MSA addendum: legal asked that BrightLayer highlight any exceptional retention or export requirements in the one-pager; otherwise we’ll route a short addendum via DocuSign as you suggested.

Mutual action plan (short):
- By 2028-07-24: BrightLayer sends roster + final addendum summary (Tom).
- By 2028-07-25: Redwood provisions sandbox project and issues scoped API keys (Jordan).
- 2028-08-02: Kickoff meeting (all) — validation of curriculum, access checks, scheduling of labs.
- 2028-08-06 — 2028-09-27: Pilot training window.

If CedarOps needs any IP allowlist entries for lab infra, please provide IP ranges and we’ll coordinate infra team.

Looking forward — see you on Aug 2.
